rules: Admission requires publishing four consecutive public weekly ship logs before an interview is granted.
Nitro is open to founders building on any chain, for teams actively building and making progress on their applications.
Each cohort runs three months: one month in person in NYC, two months remote with weekly KPI check-ins, and a demo day in front of 300+ investors.
The first cohort's applications closed on March 14, 2026; the next cohort's dates are not announced.
